sources.summary: The installable desktop platform should no longer be treated as an initial UI candidate or PoC; it should use a sellable desktop-app structure.
Tauri, Apple, and Microsoft distribution/signing docs confirm that product readiness must be separated from public distribution signing/notarization/update gates.
Desktop distribution, macOS execution, and service readiness registries define the current product and release-gate language.

unsupported_claims_removed: No public-ready claim was added because signing, notarization, updater, and clean-machine smoke remain incomplete.
